input.quote: 12.1 Term. The term of this Agreement shall commence upon the Effective Date and, unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Article XII, shall continue in full force and effect until the expiration of Sanofi's payment obligations under Article IX or the Profit/Loss Share Agreement, whichever is later (the "Term").
input.rationale: This is a collaboration/license agreement with a single fixed Term that runs until expiry of Sanofi's payment obligations; there is no automatic renewal, no renewal term, no non-renewal notice window and no renewal price-uplift mechanic (searches for "renew"/"automatically renew"/successive-term language return only unrelated patent, insurance and force majeure references). Any extension would therefore require mutual written agreement, which matches the preferred position, and Sanofi additionally holds broad termination-for-convenience rights under Section 12.2(a)(i). The auto-renewal rule is effectively not applicable, so no redline is warranted.
